name: data-audio-bars
title: Audio Bars
description: Mỗi cột là một dải tần, nhảy lên nhanh và rơi chậm hơn, cột trầm to và chậm, cột cao nhỏ và nhanh.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Bars per frequency band: rise ~100 ms ease-out, decay over 300-500 ms; bass big and slow, treble small and fast. Demo: 24 bars (7 px, 11 px pitch, max 120 px): v = (1 - f) x 0.7 x e^(-5 x beat phase) + noise(t x (3 + 10 f)) x 0.4 x (0.3 + f), a beat every 0.5 s, the 6 lowest bars in the accent. Params: bars (24) · rise (0.1 s) · fall (0.3–0.5 s). v = (1 − f) 0.7 e^(−5 · beat phase) + noise(t (3 + 10 f)) 0.4 (0.3 + f): bass big and slow on the beat, treble small and fast.
